svg.title: Lateral, medial and terminal moraine and an outwash plain
svg.desc: A plan view of two valley glaciers joining: rock shattered by freeze-thaw falls onto their edges as lateral moraines, the two inner lateral moraines join as a medial moraine, unsorted till piles up at the snout as a terminal moraine, and meltwater streams spread sorted sand and gravel beyond it as an outwash plain; a cross-section and a long profile show the same features.

text.tspan: Plan view: two valley glaciers join
e.g. outwash plain: the Curragh, Co. Kildare
